newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance down 1.5 pct by afternoon.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance down 1.5 pct by afternoon.

text.p: Shares of petrochemical giant Reliance Industries fell 5.50 rupees or nearly 1.5 percent, to 371.75 at the Bombay exchange on Friday on the last day of end-account trade, dealers said.
"There is very little activity. People are booking profits in the stock," said Manish Nathwani, dealer at local brokers Samir Doshi.
Reliance ended weeks of feverish stock market guessing on Thursday when its chairman announced a one-for-one bonus share issue following a packed annual shareholders' meeting.
The shares have surged nearly five percent in the current weekly account.
Over 4.3 million shares of Reliance changed hands at the Bombay exchange in late afternoon trade on Friday compared to 13.1 million shares traded on the previous day.
